entries.note: Build through the shared lock, copy the executable (and Windows runtime files) into a private generation, then render a real smoke frame without workspace credentials or initial sessions. A managed view uses explicit inherited bindings and its own spawn stamp. Keeping the previous executable separate from mutable build output allows automatic restoration after a failed replacement. The native build/helper paths are development inputs; installable resource relocation and Windows runtime qualification remain separate.
